isa.title: KAD Memory & Knowledge Substrate Ideal State Artifact (ISA)

claims.statement: The current state artifact declares the memory substrate together with provenance, so the substrate's existence and identity are auditable rather than assumed.
claims.evidence: CSA declares memory substrate backend "ai-memory" with provenance (COMMAND)

claims.statement: There is exactly one wiki of record: a live ai-memory project whose location is published by a pointer the current state artifact agrees with.
claims.evidence: wiki of record is live and matches the CSA: /home/amdy/Work/.ai-memory/wiki/01a090eb-c52d-7b91-b809-0d1f993c0617/01a090eb-c52d-7b91-b809-0d2e050822dc

claims.statement: Capture scope is declared for a workspace and project, and self-referential paths (the substrate and its mirror) are excluded from capture.
claims.evidence: capture scope declared for workspace=yes project=yes; self-referential paths excluded (.ai-memory/**, vault/**)

claims.statement: The committed vault mirror is an OKF v0.2 bundle: the bundle root declares okf_version and every non-reserved page carries a non-empty type.
claims.evidence: mirror is OKF v0.2 conformant: index declares okf_version, 201 pages all carry a non-empty type

claims.statement: The record carries its own git history, so knowledge versions independently of the repository that publishes its mirror.
claims.evidence: record resolves HEAD 6980a26ade4f with 1 branch ref(s) under its own git history

claims.statement: Obsidian is bound to the wiki of record, not to the derived mirror, so human editing lands on the canonical surface.
claims.evidence: Obsidian is bound to the record (5 config files); the derived mirror carries none

claims.statement: Every page in the record satisfies the OKF type requirement, so no page can be silently unclassified.
claims.evidence: all 202 record pages carry a non-empty OKF type

claims.statement: Every remote model available to KAD-PI is reachable through one OpenAI-compatible gateway endpoint registered as TRANSPORT_ONLY; local KAD inference is proxied, never delegated.
claims.evidence: gateway registered as TRANSPORT_ONLY at http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1; local inference endpoints are proxied, not delegated

claims.statement: The model catalog is refreshed deterministically from the gateway and hash-verified, so a stale or tampered catalog cannot pass as current.
claims.evidence: catalog hash verified over 1611 model ids (bd2e0164f871…)
